messages:
lucy: FYI quickstart CI started failing after SDK 0.12.3 bump. embeddings tests error with 401 but direct curl to REST passes. repo: github.com/redwood/sample-apps/llm-quickstart

evan: can you paste error?

lucy: `ERROR 401: missing Authorization header` (stack points at node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.js)

sam: sdk change log mentions new `apiKey` handling — does the sample pass apiKey or token?

lucy: constructor uses `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` (legacy env). curl uses Bearer header so it succeeds.

evan: looks like SDK now emits `X-Redwood-Key` when `apiKey` is used (for on-prem). Hosted API expects `Authorization: Bearer`. that leaked into hosted mode.

lucy: another wrinkle: sample uses `timeout_ms` but REST expects `timeout_seconds`. SDK was forwarding ms raw so gateway interpreted huge values/wrong units.

sam: two separate parity bugs: header mapping + param unit. also found the SDK retryer ignores `Retry-After` header on 429, which causes hot-loop retries in some CI runs.

evan: short term: patch quickstart to use raw fetch with `Authorization: Bearer ${REDWOOD_API_KEY}` and adjust CI to use REDWOOD_TOKEN env name. example snippet added to README.

sam: long term: revert hosted header fallback, accept both timeout_ms and timeout_seconds (normalize to ms internally), and make retryer honor Retry-After for 429/503. add e2e against hosted sandbox.

ci-bot: opened issue #4580 "SDK parity: hosted header, timeout units, retry-after handling" assigned to @evan

lucy: pushing quickfix to CI now with [quickfix] commit. will revert once patch published. thanks everyone. :tada:
